senses.gloss: The twenty-eighth consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet, the letter L.

m. (लः)
1 INDRA.
2 Cutting.
f. (ला)
1 Giving.
2 Receiving, taking.
f. (ली)
1 Embracing, adhering or clinging to.
2 Liquifying, melting.
E.
ला to give or take, &c., aff. क or ड, fem. aff. टाप् or ङीष्.

r. 2nd cl. (लाति)
1 To give.
2 To get, to receive.
